head: Your Total Calories shows active and resting calories as one number
dek: Your Total Calories adds up the active and resting calories your body burns into one number on your Apple Watch, without a big dashboard. It was #84 among paid Health & Fitness apps on the US App Store on 5 November.
details: It costs $1.99 with in-app purchases, by Silentstar Group.
where: Apple Watch and iPhone, App Store, $1.99
means: If you track calories, it shows the full day's burn, not just workouts.
todo: You need an Apple Watch; find it in the App Store.
thumb_words: ALL YOUR CALORIES IN ONE NUMBER
